title: C: Date/Time Library
description: Use the time.h library to get the current time and format it as a readable string.

steps.description: Use `time()`, `localtime()`, and `strftime()` to print the current date and time formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'. Since the sandbox may not have real time, simulate by generating a date string.
